name: Rework tabs within settings page.
description:
Right now we have a concept of "global" and "own list" for many settings inside of preferences.

It's hard for the user to navigate this.

- Remove tabs from the UI

- Instead of tabs, duplicate the sidebar item, once for global and once for the board sections. Ie. stages should have an item under the "Global" section AND under "Board: <board name>". Under global it shows items that are global, under board it shows the board level items. Make sure to include verbiage about inhertance.
